people.imagined: The water-carrier, short of breath after every flight of steps, learning to breathe on the climb.
people.subject: The moment: halting on a cliff stair in the early haze, chest heaving, two buckets hanging from a pole across his shoulders, learning to breathe on the climb. Face: a thin, flushed, honest face of thirty, brown, with an open gasping mouth, tired kind eyes, thick brows, a blunt nose and a bead of sweat hanging from the chin. Hair: black, damp and tied back with a plain cord. Body: wiry and stooped, bent forward with both hands on the pole, knees slightly flexed. Clothing: a servant's clean, simple robe of soft undyed grey-green cloth with a crossed collar and a faded green-grey sash, darkened with sweat at the back, a folded cloth pad on one shoulder flattened by years of use; plain but tidy and graceful in its folds, with no ornament at all. Hands and objects: palms polished smooth on the pole; both wooden buckets are tied with knotted rope, the water inside clear as spirit-spring water with a green leaf floating in one, a little slopping over the rim in glittering drops. Power: none; only a few pale motes of green haze drifting up the stair behind him. Background: a steep cliff stair cut into dark rock, drifting haze and long shadows below. Light: cool silver morning light from the upper left, a soft rim light along his wet shoulder, the buckets flashing. Expression: tired and determined, gasping with no complaint, the look of a man who will make the next landing.

people.imagined: Dike mud to the knees all year, believing the spirit rice is bread.
people.subject: The moment: standing calf-deep in a salt-marsh dike at dusk, both hands folded on top of a spade with his chin resting on them, calm and trusting, believing the spirit rice is bread. Face: a weathered, plain, trusting face of twenty-three, dark-skinned and windburned, with round eyes, thick brows, a flat nose and a smear of grey mud across one cheek. Hair: black and short. Body: sturdy, standing square and relaxed. Clothing: the simple graceful robe of an outer disciple of Thúy Vi: haze-dyed green-grey silk, two crossed collars lightly embroidered at the edge with silver herb sprigs, wide sleeves tied back, the hem tucked up into a plain grey sash, mud caked to the knees and drying pale on one sleeve; it is the plainest silk of the house, clean and soft. Hands and objects: a spade with a pale smooth handle and a bright blade; a faint blue water haze around the blade. Power: a very faint green-blue shimmer at his sleeves, almost nothing. Background: long dikes holding back still grey water under mist, a patch of green rice shoots, gulls wheeling, pale motes floating over the marsh. Light: grey silver spirit-light from the upper left, soft on his round face, a thin line of moonlike glint on the wet mud. Expression: trusting and diligent, a plain open calm of a man who has never had cause to doubt the work.

people.imagined: A salt-fish seller's daughter wearing a fish-scale earring, following a boy everywhere.
people.subject: The moment: peeking round the corner of a lantern-lit harbour alley at dusk, glancing at someone out of frame with a keen sly smile, following a boy everywhere. Face: a round, pretty face of twenty-one, brown, with flushed cheeks, bright sly dark eyes under long lashes, arched brows, a small nose and a hidden smile; a silver fish-scale earring dangles from her ear and flashes. Hair: black, in a high tail held by a small carved bone comb with a green silk ribbon. Body: slim, leaning out from the wall with one hand on the corner and the other cupped near her mouth, head tilted, toes lifted. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple of Thúy Vi: a green-grey haze-dyed robe with two crossed collars, narrow sleeves with a faint silver herb border, and a pale grey sash tied in a bow with a tiny jade bead on its tassel. Hands and objects: one hand on the wall, nails pink and neat, a thin braided cord at her wrist. Power: a faint blue shimmer of water qi around the earring, nothing more. Background: a narrow harbour alley with fish racks, a hanging net, paper lanterns glowing amber, her shadow on the wall, soft mist. Light: warm lantern glow from the upper left over cool blue dusk, a bright rim light picking out the silver scale. Expression: sly and curious, bright and hungry, the look of a salt-fish seller's daughter who thinks no one has noticed her.

people.imagined: A fighter whose steady gaze skirts one stretch of the river, never asking why his teacher avoids it.
people.subject: The moment: standing on river ice in the blue hour, his gaze steady but carefully skirting one dark stretch of water at the edge of the frame, jaw tight, never asking why his teacher avoids it. Face: a lean, sharp, calm face of twenty-five, pale, with steady grey eyes fixed deliberately away, thin brows, a straight nose, a firm thin-lipped mouth and a muscle ticking in the jaw. Hair: black, tied back in a high knot with a plain jade pin. Body: lean and strong, standing square on the ice with feet apart. Clothing: the inner-disciple robe of Thúy Vi: three layers of haze-green silk with a pale green silk inner collar and a dark green cord at the waist, a pale grey fur collar frosted with rime, wide sleeves bound at the wrists with silver-grey ribbon, collars edged with silver mist-and-herb embroidery. Hands and objects: an iron ice-spike held point down, its shaft wrapped in blue cord, rime on the iron. Power: a faint blue frost of water qi curls around his wrists and drifts in the cold air. Background: river ice stretching in white-blue sheets under mist, a dark stretch of water glinting at the edge of the frame, his breath hanging in the air, pale motes of light. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left lying on his lean face, a white glare of ice lighting his lower lip, soft rim light on the fur. Expression: calm and cautious, loyal, a held, level look that refuses to turn toward what it knows is there.

people.imagined: A deck hand proud of a tuft of beard, who promised eagle feathers and sold them.
people.subject: The moment: leaning back against a barrel on the deck of a pill ship at golden dusk, stroking a small tuft of beard with a sly grin while one hand hides a white feather behind him; he promised eagle feathers and sold them. Face: a young, sly, tanned face of twenty-two, sun-freckled across a snub nose, bright shifty dark eyes, thick brows, a wide delighted grin, and a small proud tuft of wispy dark beard on the chin. Hair: black, wind-tossed, with a short blue ribbon. Body: lean, chest out and chin lifted, one foot crossed over the other. Clothing: the simple silk robe of an outer disciple of Thúy Vi, green-grey with two crossed collars and a faint silver herb border, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a sea-blue silk sash knotted at the side with a small shell tassel, a short oiled-silk sea vest, and a pocket that bulges with something feathery. Hands and objects: one hand at the beard, the hidden hand holding a long white feather that curls round his hip. Power: only a faint blue shimmer of sea spray drifting about him. Background: the carved deck of a pill ship, coiled ropes, a lantern, a wide glowing sea and sky of lilac and gold, a gull. Light: warm sea-light from the upper left, spray glinting on his sleeve and hair, a soft rim light. Expression: cheeky and greedy, a guilty, delighted grin pleased with its own lie.

people.imagined: A herder girl with a long stride playing the flute softly to spirit cattle at dusk.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a spirit pasture at dusk, playing a bamboo flute very softly with her eyes closed, spirit cattle lying in the glowing grass behind her. Face: a long, tanned, calm face of twenty-three with thick brows, a straight nose and closed eyelids resting still, the flute at her lips. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with green silk cord and a small jade bead. Body: tall and long-limbed, her weight on one long leg, elbows lifted, head slightly tilted. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple of Thúy Vi, a green-grey robe cut a little short for a long stride, two crossed collars, wide sleeves falling in soft folds with a faint silver herb border, a pale grey sash with a bamboo switch tucked in it, and slim embroidered boots. Hands and objects: both long hands on a pale bamboo flute with five finger-holes. Power: a gentle green-gold tint of wood qi, a few soft motes drifting from the flute like fireflies; the nearest cow's horns glow faintly in answer. Background: a dusk pasture, the dark shapes of spirit cattle lying down, a lilac sky and the first star, mist low over the grass. Light: lilac spirit-light from the upper left giving her face a soft violet cast, a gentle gold rim light on the braid. Expression: gentle and focused, the unhurried stillness of a herder who has found the tune the cattle like.

people.imagined: A Marten Yard junior with sleepy silver marten kits peeking out of both cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still in a moonlit hutch yard with her arms held up stiffly in front of her, two thumb-sized silver marten kits peeking sleepily from her cuffs; she is afraid of waking them. Face: a soft, round, rosy face of twenty, fair, with bright green-brown delighted eyes, thin brows, a button nose and a shy held-breath smile. Hair: light brown, in two buns pinned with tiny silver combs and green ribbons. Body: small, shoulders lifted, chin tucked. Clothing: the inner-disciple robe of Thúy Vi: three layers of haze-green silk with a pale green silk inner collar and a dark green cord at the waist, a translucent green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves whose cuffs are lined with silver-grey fur, collars embroidered in silver with herbs and mist, and a small silk bag of kit-food hung from her sash with a jade bead. Hands and objects: both arms raised, the kits' small round ears and shut eyes at the cuffs, silver whiskers trembling. Power: a faint silver-green wood qi tints the fur and drifts upward as a few soft motes. Background: a yard of carved wooden hutches with straw, older silver martens perched on a post, pine boughs, soft mist. Light: soft silver moonlight from the upper left lighting the fur and the pink of her cheeks, a gentle rim light along her sleeves. Expression: tender and delighted, afraid of ending the moment.

people.imagined: He came to the Green Door at twelve with a broken arm set slightly crooked, carrying water ever since.
people.subject: The moment: crossing a quiet courtyard at dawn with a water pail hanging from his right forearm, which he holds out a little crooked; he came to the Green Door at twelve with a broken arm set slightly crooked, and has carried water ever since. Face: a quiet, thin, plain face of twenty-one, brown, with sad kind eyes, thin brows, a long nose, thin lips and a faint line by the mouth. Hair: black and short. Body: lean and slightly hunched, shoulders drawn in as if used to being overlooked, the faint stoop of long carrying. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple of Thúy Vi: a haze-dyed green-grey robe with two crossed collars and a faint silver herb border, the right sleeve rolled to show the bowed forearm, a loosely tied pale blue Healing House sash, clean and soft though simple. Hands and objects: the rope of a wooden pail rests across the crooked arm and the palm; his thin fingers are a little blue with cold. Power: none; only a few pale green motes of haze at the courtyard edge. Background: a door painted green, a stone threshold, a quiet courtyard of pale flagstones, mist drifting, one paper lantern still lit. Light: soft silver dawn light from the upper left, gentle on his thin face, a faint rim light along the bowed arm and the stoop of his back. Expression: quiet and grateful, lonely, the mild lowered look of a man who is happy to be allowed to stay.

people.imagined: A former pill thief with a pocket that clinks, grinning as he runs errands.
people.subject: The moment: sprinting through a lantern-hung market street, grinning, one hand clamped over a pocket that clinks; a former pill thief, now running errands for the sect's shop. Face: a thin, wiry, grinning face of eighteen, brown, with bright shifty eyes, thick brows, a sharp nose and a small scab on the chin. Hair: black and spiky, with a green ribbon tied round the knot. Body: skinny, running on the balls of his feet, leaning forward, one arm swinging and the other pressed to the pocket. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple of Thúy Vi: a short green-grey robe cut for running, crossed collars with a faint silver herb border, wide sleeves tied back with cord, a pill-shop runner's green cord tight round the waist and bouncing, and soft cloth sandals. Hands and objects: the hand over the sagging pocket, the copper coins inside bound in a cloth with string so they cannot ring, though they do. Power: a faint streak of green-gold wood qi trails from his heels, almost nothing. Background: a busy market street of awnings, hanging lanterns glowing amber, blurred crowds, steam from stalls, drifting motes. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left slicing across the awnings and glinting off the coins, a soft rim light on his hair. Expression: cheeky and quick, a darting, delighted grin of a boy who has not yet stopped running from being caught.

people.imagined: A midwife's first disciple with brisk, clean-nailed hands, wanting to be on the step every day.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight at a basin in a bright healing room, drying her scrubbed hands, ready for the next patient. Face: a bright, neat, rosy face of nineteen with brown eyes, neat brows, a small nose and a brisk, eager smile; her cheeks are rosy and her mouth set in readiness. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a single green jade pin. Body: small and quick, elbows in, hands raised to chest height like a surgeon's. Clothing: the inner-disciple robe of Thúy Vi: haze-green silk in three crossed layers with a pale green silk inner collar and a dark green cord at the waist, wide sleeves tied neatly above the elbow with silver-grey ribbons, collars embroidered at the edge in silver with herbs, a white silk healer's over-sash, and a folded towel over one shoulder. Hands and objects: spotless pale clean nails on quick pink hands from scrubbing; a small basin of clear water at her side with a gleam on its surface. Power: a faint warm green wood qi hovers around her fingertips, a few soft motes rising. Background: a healing room with pallets in neat rows, hanging herb bundles, sun-warmed paper windows and drifting haze. Light: bright soft spirit-light from the upper left, clean on her face and bouncing off the basin, a gentle rim light along her sleeves. Expression: brisk, eager and kind, a midwife's first disciple who wants to be on the step every day.

people.imagined: Walking in the haze on a path, a council held on foot. The damp hem, the tea-stained thumb, the whisk like a fly-swat in his belt. He is thinking of whom to hand the sect to.
people.subject: The moment: walking a misty path, he stops and turns with a mild, interested look, a council held on foot, thinking of whom to hand the sect to. Face: a small, round-shouldered man of about fifty-five with a round, plain, kind face, weathered light brown, small mild dark eyes, thin grey brows, a blunt nose, a gentle half-smile, large slightly uneven ears, a few grey whiskers missed by the razor and fine smile-lines at the eyes. Hair: grey-black, in a plain topknot under a small jade-green crown with a wooden pin. Body: short, round-shouldered and relaxed. Clothing: the head's robe of Thúy Vi: layers of jade-green brocade over haze-green silk, three crossed collars embroidered in silver with herbs and mist, a translucent green gauze over-robe that hangs like haze, wide sleeves, a grey scarf at the neck, and a braided cord belt hung with a small tea-gourd and a jade pendant; the hem is darker and damp from the path. Hands and objects: a white horsehair whisk pushed through his belt like a fly-swat; a small clay tea bowl in one hand, the thumb stained brown with tea. Power: a soft jade-green wood qi lies about him like breathing haze, drifting motes of green light gathering at his sleeves; gentle but deep. Background: tall dark pine trunks evenly spaced in pale green haze, a stone step leading down a slope, a small paper lantern on a bough. Light: pale silver spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glow along his shoulder. Expression: mild and interested, with a soft unhurried half-smile as he turns.

people.imagined: At the founder's grave on the ridge, dry in the cold, refusing to stand in the haze. She is thinking of her disciple and what the ridge made the sect.
people.subject: The moment: standing by an old grave under a sideways-bending pine on the ridge, tall and unmoving, she gives the viewer a long hard stare, refusing to stand in the haze and thinking of her disciple and what the ridge made the sect. Face: she appears about sixty-five, with a tall, narrow, bony, pale weathered face, deep lines, sharp pale grey eyes, thick straight grey brows, a long hooked nose, a bloodless flat hard mouth, cheekbones sharp as blades and fine dry lines across the cheeks like cracks in old bark. Hair: grey, cut straight at the jaw, held by a single long jade pin. Body: tall, bony and straight-backed. Clothing: the grand elder's robe in the old ridge style: stiff layered silk the colour of old bone, undyed and spotless, bone dry despite the mist, with a collar crossed in the ridge fashion, wide plain sleeves, a jade-green brocade sash and a small jade crown, a jade herb pendant at the belt, no green on the robe itself. Hands and objects: bark-cracked grey hands folded before her. Power: a cold dark green-brown mist coils at her feet and the pine behind her seems to lean toward her; a dry, stern pressure in the air, stronger than anyone nearby. Background: a weathered stone marker at the foot of a huge pine propped by pale braces, the ridge falling away into a sea of cloud, a few blank banners fluttering. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left, a hard pale rim along her shoulders. Expression: a long, hard, dry stare with a tight mouth and unyielding features.

people.imagined: At the Green Furnace, tasting a pill, lips tinted green; he wants to brew correctly the pill that killed his teacher.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the Green Furnace, he lifts a pill to his lips and tastes it with a long, quiet, analytical look; he wants to brew correctly the pill that killed his teacher. Face: a lean, long, dry face of about fifty, pale, with hollow cheeks, deep-set sharply focused dark eyes, thick black brows, a sharp nose, a thin mouth whose lips and gums are tinted faintly green from three centuries of tasting pills, and a pale line of old burn-marks along the jaw. Hair: black with iron grey, in a topknot under a small jade-green crown with a green jade pin. Body: lean, upright and taut. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi: jade-green brocade over layered haze-green silk, three crossed collars embroidered in silver with herbs and mist, wide sleeves bound tight at the wrists with silver cords against sparks, a translucent green gauze over-robe singed brown at its hem, and an elder's green silk sash stained near the knot with one dark drop of tincture. Hands and objects: a pill between soot-darkened fingertips, soot in the creases of his knuckles. Power: green fire shimmers around the pill and a faint ring of jade-green wood qi and heat rises about his shoulders, motes of sparks drifting up. Background: the great Green Furnace, squat with a mouth of pale green flame, copper pipes along the walls, racks of small bowls and tongs, thin smoke rising to dark rafters. Light: green furnace glow from the lower left, a pale silver rim along his sleeve. Expression: diligent and ambitious, grimly honest, the look of a man reading a pill by its smell.

people.imagined: In a field at winter dusk, broad and slow, brown as the earth, scars of lime-burn on both forearms.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a winter field at dusk, broad and slow, scooping up earth and letting it fall through his fingers, reading the soil at the end of the day. Face: a broad, slow face of about fifty, brown as a winter field, with patient dark eyes slightly yellowed at the whites, thick black brows, a broad nose, a quiet mouth, short grey stubble, a thick creased neck and big brown ears. Hair: black with grey at the temples, cropped short under a small jade-green crown. Body: broad, heavy and slow. Clothing: the robe of the first elder of Thúy Vi: jade-green brocade collars over haze-green silk in three crossed layers, mended neatly at the cuffs, wide sleeves rolled above the elbows, a thick sleeveless quilted over-vest of pale grey silk dusted white at the hem and tied with silk toggles, an elder's sash with a small pouch of seed and a jade herb pendant, and clean embroidered boots with clay on the soles. Hands and objects: pale lime-burn scars mottle both bare thick forearms, and soil lies dark under every nail; a handful of dark earth falls through his fingers. Power: a warm brown earth qi gathers about him like slow haze, with glowing motes rising from the soil in his hands; steady and deep. Background: a long winter field of ploughed furrows running to a line of bare trees, a lone ox standing steaming, thin smoke from a kiln chimney, a rose-and-grey sky. Light: low warm spirit-light from the upper left, a soft gold rim along his shoulder. Expression: diligent and humble, the settled unhurried look of a man who has finished the day's work.

people.imagined: On the Hàn Tân quay in the morning, the lamp unlit at his hip, a white scar in his eyebrow from the ice; he wants the border pushed back.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the Hàn Tân stone quay in the cold blue morning, squinting across a broad river toward a border, jaw set, wanting the border pushed back. Face: a weathered, thick-necked, heavy-jawed face of about fifty, red-brown, with narrow pale nearly lashless eyes from ice glare, thick grey brows, a flat nose, red-veined cheeks, a hard mouth, and a white scar slicing straight through the left eyebrow and parting it in two. Hair: grey-black, cropped short under a small silver-green crown. Body: thick-necked and broad. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi: jade-green brocade collars over haze-green silk, three crossed layers, a heavy dark winter coat of black silk-wool lined with grey fur at throat and cuffs and edged with silver embroidery of waves and herbs, a blue Cold Ford sash wound twice round the waist, and an old brass quay lamp with a ring handle, dull with age and unlit, hung at the hip with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands gripping a spear shaft, its blade wrapped in pale cloth. Power: blue frost qi gathers around the spear and cold breath curls from his mouth; a faint ring of ice crystals drifts about him, strong and heavy. Background: the quay's stone edge running into fog over a broad river, a long wooden boat with a lantern at its prow, watch-posts dark on the far bank. Light: cold silver morning light from the upper left, a hard pale rim along his coat. Expression: warlike and brave, a hard squint that does not blink at the glare.

people.imagined: On a harbour, laughing a laugh that carries, a whale-cast brass lock on a cord at her throat, rolling walk; looking south for her father's sabre.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a harbour quay at sunset, laughing with her head thrown back, a laugh that carries across the water, looking south for her father's sabre. Face: she appears about sixty-two, a short woman with salt-cracked brown skin full of lines, bright small black eyes, thick white bristly brows that rise as she laughs, a flat nose, white uneven teeth in a wide open mouth, a tiny gold hoop in one ear, and on a cord at her throat a thumb-sized brass lock with a keyhole cast from a whale-bone mould. Hair: white, in a short sea-knot with a bit of blue cord under a small silver-blue crown. Body: short, rolling and broad, both hands thrown wide in the gesture. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi: jade-green brocade collars over haze-green silk hitched at the knee, a short cape of salt-white oiled silk stiff at the folds, a dark blue port-house sash with a knotted rope tail and a jade pendant, wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs in silver waves. Hands and objects: the brass lock bright against her dark skin. Power: blue water qi curls about her like sea spray, glittering droplets rising and falling in the air; broad and strong. Background: a harbour quay crowded with masts and furled sails, barrels, salt-chests and rope coils, gulls wheeling against a wind-swept sky of rose and gold, a sail-boat heeling in the bay. Light: warm sea-light from the upper left, a bright rim along her laughing face. Expression: a huge rolling laugh, crinkled eyes, a wide mouth and a gleam of wanting.

people.imagined: In a garden at morning, sleeves rolled, a moss-furred mirror at her waist, soft-spoken; she keeps the sect quiet and green.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a garden bed at morning, she looks up softly with her sleeves rolled to the elbows, a small bright green sprout resting in her palm; she keeps the sect quiet and green. Face: a slight, gentle, narrow face of thirty-five, fair, with pale grey-green eyes like young leaves, soft straight thin brows, a small straight nose, a small still soft smile and faint freckles over the cheekbones. Hair: dark brown, in a loose low knot with a green silk cord and a jade hairpin shaped like a leaf. Body: slight and slim. Clothing: the robe of a true disciple of Thúy Vi: haze-green silk in three crossed layers with a pale green silk collar and sash, a translucent green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves rolled twice above the elbow to expose slender wrists stained green at the nails, collars embroidered in silver with herbs and mist, a jade herb pendant at her sash, and the knees damp with garden earth. Hands and objects: a small round bronze mirror furred green with moss hangs at her waist from a plaited green cord; the sprout in her palm shows a pale green sparkle on its leaves. Power: a gentle wood-green qi glows around her hands and the seedlings nearest her lean toward her, soft motes rising; deep and quiet. Background: a long bed of herb seedlings in orderly rows, a bamboo trellis with climbing vines, a stone path, soft morning mist glowing gold at the edges. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left with a gold rim. Expression: compassionate and humble, the patient soft-spoken attention of a woman looking at a seedling.

people.imagined: On the ridge, burnt dark by the wind, a long cypress banner-pole across his back, wanting to bring the sect's heart back up the mountain.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high ridge in a fierce wind, glaring into the distance with arrogant certainty, wanting to bring the sect's heart back up the mountain. Face: a tall, hard face of about forty, burnt by the wind to the colour of dark tea, with taut cheeks, fierce narrow dark eyes, heavy straight brows, a strong straight nose, a set mouth and a pale scar nicking the chin. Hair: black, cropped short beneath a slim silver-green crown. Body: tall, broad and hard. Clothing: the robe of a true disciple of the Cliff Hall of Thúy Vi: dry undyed silk in the old ridge style, spotless, in crossed layers with a collar edged in silver embroidery of mist, under a long grey wind-coat of silk woven with a metallic sheen, a jade herb pendant at the sash, and dark stone-cutter's bracers of plain lacquered leather at the wrists. Hands and objects: a long plain cypress banner-pole, smooth and dark with a bare crossbar and no cloth, rises behind his shoulder across his back; heavily calloused hands folded across his chest. Power: a steel-grey sheen runs over the coat and pale grey-green wood qi streams from the hem in the wind like ribbons; hard and heavy. Background: a high bare ridge of grey rock against a pale spirit-lit sky, loose scree sliding at the edge, a single scrubby pine leaning in the gale. Light: hard bright moonlight from the upper left with a sharp rim along his shoulders. Expression: arrogant and stubborn, a narrowed stare of a man used to staring down a gale.

people.imagined: Talking fast while he walks fast, chalk on his cuffs, an old man in a hurry to hear the ninth layer read right.
people.subject: The moment: mid-stride and mid-sentence on a misty stone path, gesturing quickly with chalk-white hands, an old man in a hurry to hear the ninth layer read right. Face: a wiry, narrow, quick old face of about sixty, brown, deeply seamed, with bright darting dark eyes under thick white brows, a sharp nose slightly red at the end, and a quick open mouth, every wrinkle seeming to be in the middle of a word. Hair: white and wild, tied in a short tail under a small silver-green crown. Body: thin, wiry and forward-leaning. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi: jade-green brocade collars over haze-green silk hitched at the sash for walking, a green array-hall sash with a jade pendant, wide sleeves embroidered in silver with herbs and mist, white array chalk smeared thick over both cuffs and the front, and a bundle of chalk sticks poking from one sleeve. Hands and objects: a stick of chalk in one hand, fingers white with dust. Power: faint green lines of array-light trail behind his hand where it moved, glowing motes and a haze of wood qi swirling about his sleeves; lively and strong. Background: a row of lichen-covered array stones disappearing into pale haze, a stone path winding between them, a few distant pines showing through the mist. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, a faint green glow rising from the stones, a pale rim along his shoulder. Expression: generous, gregarious and impatient, the eager tumbling look of a man talking faster than he can walk.

people.imagined: A small stooped woman in a herb garden smelling of angelica root, a burn scar on her cheek from the fire that took a hall.
people.subject: The moment: small and stooped in a herb garden at dusk, she looks up with a quiet, cautious look, holding a root of angelica in both hands. Face: she appears about sixty, with a small, lined, brown face, wary kind dark eyes with drooping lids, thin grey brows, a small nose, a thoughtful mouth, and a shiny pale-pink burn scar along her left cheek from jaw to ear, tight and plainly visible, puckering the corner of her mouth. Hair: white-grey, in a bun with a plain jade pin under a small crown of silver-green. Body: small and stooped. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi: soft haze-green silk in three crossed layers, neatly mended at the elbows, with jade-green brocade collars faded with age, an elder's grey-green sash gone soft, a herb-stained silk over-apron tinted yellow with angelica, and a small cloth bag of dried root at her belt beside a jade herb pendant. Hands and objects: the pale angelica root held in both hands. Power: a warm green-gold wood qi gathers about the root and her hands, soft motes drifting like pollen; calm, deep and old. Background: rows of herb beds in neat squares, a bamboo frame with drying leaves, a low stone wall, mist rising from the ground. Light: soft silver-lilac spirit-light from the upper left, a faint green glow from the garden, a gentle rim along her shoulder. Expression: patient and honest, the careful steady look of a woman who has been burned by a fire that took a hall and now watches every spark.

people.imagined: Standing very straight at the Hall of Rules, speaking in the fewest words he can; he dug for nine days once.
people.subject: The moment: standing perfectly straight at the door of the Hall of Rules, unsmiling, about to give a one-word verdict; he once dug for nine days. Face: an utterly stern square face of about forty-five, brown, with a clean-shaven blue-grey jaw, steady dark eyes that never blink long, heavy straight brows with deep vertical lines between them, a strong nose and a closed hard mouth, silver at the temples. Hair: black, cut sharp and grey at the temples, cropped under a small dark jade crown. Body: square and straight, hands at his sides. Clothing: the robe of an elder of the Hall of Rules of Thúy Vi: dry undyed silk in the old ridge style, immaculate and formal, layered in three crossed collars closed to the throat, narrow sleeves with fastened cuffs edged in a thin silver mist border, a dark jade-green brocade sash tied flat, and a small flat plain jade tablet hanging at the belt. Hands and objects: hands at his sides, still. Power: a heavy grey-green earth and wood qi presses quietly around him like a held breath, the motes in the air settling toward the floor as if obeying him; strong and still. Background: a plain hall with bare dark pillars, a long polished floor, a single pale window with mist beyond; nothing is decorated. Light: cool silver light from the upper left, flat and exact, a thin rim along his shoulder. Expression: just and stern, the fixed unsmiling gaze of a man who speaks in the fewest words he can and means all of them.

people.imagined: The Marten Yard keeper, whose fur collar is a living silver marten sleeping round her neck.
people.subject: The moment: in a pine yard at golden hour, sharp-eyed and quick, she strokes with one hand the silver marten asleep around her neck like a fur collar. Face: a sharp, quick, thin face of about forty, brown, with a pointed chin, bright fast dark eyes, thin arched brows, a long thin nose that wrinkles when she sniffs, a thin sly smile and a pale line of an old scratch across one cheek. Hair: black, in a tight high knot with a green jade pin and silver ribbons. Body: lean and quick. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi: haze-green silk in three crossed layers with jade-green brocade collars, a translucent green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves embroidered in silver with herbs and mist, a green elder's sash hung with a jade pendant and a pouch of dried meat, and one scratched glove of dark silk-leather on the left hand. Hands and objects: one hand stroking her spirit beast, a living silver marten curled round her neck, plump and drowsy, its small face resting on her shoulder and its tail hanging over it. Power: a silver-green sheen of wood qi lights the marten's fur and spreads to her shoulders, a few motes drifting upward like seeds; quick and strong. Background: a pine yard with carved wooden hutches and perches, small silver shapes darting among the roots, sunlight slanting through branches in golden beams. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, a bright rim on the marten's fur. Expression: reclusive and sly, greedy, the knowing sidelong look of the Marten Yard keeper who trusts her animals more than the people who come to ask for them.

people.imagined: Elegant in a Tùng Đào-cut robe dyed Thúy Vi green, quick eyes weighing a courtesy; she speaks both sects' courtesies.
people.subject: The moment: giving a half-courtesy bow in a pale audience hall, with a slight smile, her quick eyes weighing the viewer; she speaks both sects' courtesies. Face: an elegant, quick-eyed, oval face of thirty-eight, fair and fine-skinned, with sharp bright dark eyes that judge every word, thin arched brows, a fine straight nose, lips painted a faint rose and a polished smile; a tiny jade drop swings from each ear. Hair: black, in an elaborate high coil with a pine-green jade pin and silver tassels. Body: slim and graceful, one hand extended in greeting. Clothing: the robe of an elder of Thúy Vi cut in the wide-collared Pine Palace fashion: a deep V collar of jade-green brocade edged with thin pine-green piping over layered haze-green silk, a perfectly even grey-green dye, a translucent green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves lined in a lighter shade and embroidered at the cuffs in silver, a pale green silk sash tied in a flat bow, and a small jade seal-box at her hip. Hands and objects: one slender hand extended, palm down. Power: a faint jade-green sheen of wood qi lies over her sleeves and a few soft motes of light rise about her coil; polished and strong. Background: a pale audience hall with lacquered pillars, a screen painted with distant pines and no writing, and mist-soft light from tall lattice windows. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle rim along her sleeve. Expression: a polite, slight smile with quick eyes that weigh the viewer and a smooth, courteous brow.

people.imagined: At a jade seam, grey with stone dust, missing the last finger of his left hand to a jade saw; he wants one flawless seal.
people.subject: The moment: in a jade workshop at morning, he holds a translucent green stone up to the window light, calm and exacting; he wants one flawless seal. Face: a broad, heavy, square face of about fifty-five, dark, grey with powdery stone dust that settles in the creases, with deep-set steady still eyes, thick grey brows, a blunt nose and a calm mouth. Hair: grey, short, powdered with dust, under a small plain silver crown. Body: broad, with thick wrists. Clothing: the robe of a guest elder of Thúy Vi: dark grey-green silk in three crossed layers with brocade collars, the sleeves rolled above the wrists, a dark grey guest elder's sash with a small jade pendant, a protective over-apron of dark lacquered silk scored with fine saw-marks and holding small jade chips in its pocket, and fine green dust lining the cuffs. Hands and objects: the left hand lifted to show the last finger missing, a clean smooth pink stump taken by a jade saw; the right hand holds the translucent green jade up to the light. Power: a faint green-metal gleam runs through the jade and gathers on his fingertips as pale motes of metal qi; precise and strong. Background: a workshop of jade saws, grinding wheels and trays of green offcuts, a bright window and a bench of tools. Light: bright spirit-light from the upper left shining through the jade and throwing a green glow onto his face. Expression: calm and honest, reclusive, an exacting, unhurried stillness as he studies the flaw.

people.imagined: A long-armed gentle healer with a satchel and green-stained fingertips, on the Green Door Day, wanting it every day.
people.subject: The moment: at a green-painted door on the Green Door Day, he opens his long arms to receive a child, gentle and trusting; he wishes it were every day. Face: a long, kind, open face of thirty-eight, fair, with warm slightly watery brown eyes, soft slanting brows, a long nose, a gentle smile and faint laugh-lines on the cheeks. Hair: brown, in a loose knot with a pale green ribbon and a jade pin. Body: tall, long-armed and slightly stooped. Clothing: the robe of an elder of the Healing House of Thúy Vi: haze-green silk in three crossed layers with jade-green brocade collars, a translucent green gauze over-robe, wide sleeves rolled above the elbow, an elder's pale green silk sash loosely knotted with a jade herb pendant, silver herb embroidery at the hem, and a few herb leaves clinging to the cloth. Hands and objects: wide, green-tipped hands, the green tinting the nails and cuticles and gone into the lines of the palm, the colour of crushed leaves; a healer's satchel of soft brown leather worn smooth, with a brass clasp, at his side. Power: a warm green wood qi glows around his open hands and sleeves, soft motes of light drifting down like blossom; gentle and strong. Background: a bright green-painted door open on a courtyard where small figures queue, paper lanterns hanging under the eaves, dust motes in the light. Light: warm morning spirit-light from the upper left with a gold rim. Expression: compassionate and trusting, a warm, wide-open look that has room for everyone in the queue.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age she came to the empty mountain, a painter's daughter who walked into landscapes.
people.subject: The moment: the founder at the age she came to the empty mountain, a painter's daughter who walked into landscapes, seen at the edge of a misty landscape and looking toward it, her portrait faded like old silk. Face: she appears about fifty, with a fine-boned, serene face, pale skin, deep dark eyes with a dreamy faraway gaze toward a misty mountain, thin arched brows, a small nose, a slight smile, fine pale lines at the brow, and soft mist drifting across her lower face. Hair: black, long and loose, with a trailing green silk ribbon and a single jade pin. Body: slim and light. Clothing: the old-style robe of the founder of Thúy Vi, wide-sleeved and flowing: layers of green-grey silk, the dye almost faded to silver, with a collar crossed in the old fashion, a translucent gauze over-robe damp at the hem and drifting like haze, silver embroidery of herbs and mist at the borders, and a pale jade pendant on a thin sash; her stained fingertips show a painter's habit. Hands and objects: one slender hand lifted a little, as if to hold a brush. Power: a faint pale green mist gathers about her sleeves, and drifting motes of light rise toward the mountains, soft and ancient. Background: blue-grey mountains rising one behind another in soft mist, pale pines on a slope, a single winding path vanishing into cloud. Light: a soft pale moonlit glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk. Expression: dreamy and devoted, a gaze that goes beyond the frame.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the first Furnace Master at the age he burned spirit wood green, a cauldron held up at the moment the roof came down.
people.subject: The moment: the first Furnace Master at the age he burned spirit wood green, braced with a great cauldron lifted high at the moment the roof came down, his portrait faded like old silk. Face: a lean, strong face of about fifty, brown, glistening with sweat, with dark eyes fixed on the flame, thick brows, a hooked nose and a firm mouth, neck cords taut and jaw clenched, green light playing on the cheek. Hair: black, tied back with a cord under a plain old-style jade crown. Body: lean with broad shoulders, legs wide and arms trembling as he lifts the heavy cauldron. Clothing: the old-style robe of the first Furnace Master: layered green-grey silk in crossed collars, scorched at the cuffs with the wide sleeves bound tight to the forearms by silver cords, a dark singed silk over-apron blackened at the hem, a translucent gauze over-robe curling in the heat, and a jade pendant on his sash. Hands and objects: both hands on the cauldron's handle, forearms corded with strain, the cauldron's rim glowing. Power: a green fire burns in the furnace mouth beside him and sparks of pale green flame fly past; a strong green-gold glow of fire and wood qi surrounds the cauldron and his shoulders. Background: a dark hall with roof beams creaking, the green furnace glowing in an unusual colour, smoke rolling along the ceiling and his huge shadow thrown on the wall. Light: green glow from the lower left; the whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, with darkened edges. Expression: resolved and unflinching, a clenched face that has decided not to let go.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the first Warden holding the quay for four years, spear planted, refusing to yield.
people.subject: The moment: the first Warden of the Cold Ford at the age he held the quay for four years, standing with a long spear planted upright beside him and refusing to yield, his portrait faded like old silk. Face: a broad, weathered face of about forty-five, brown, with steady unflinching dark eyes, thick brows, a strong nose, a set mouth and lines of long vigil carved around it. Hair: black, tied back in a topknot under a plain old-style silver crown. Body: broad and braced, rooted on the stone with the shoulders squared. Clothing: the old-style robe of the first Warden: layered green-grey silk with crossed collars and wide sleeves bound at the wrist, a dark matted fur collar lifting slightly in the wind, crossing straps of dark lacquered silk-leather over the chest edged in silver, a blue sash and a jade pendant; plain and old but dignified. Hands and objects: both hands on the shaft of the spear, its iron head glinting with a faint blue frost. Power: blue frost qi spreads from the spearhead along the stone, and cold white mist coils at his feet and gathers at his shoulders in glittering motes; heavy and steady. Background: a stone quay running into a pale river, low fog creeping, a lone boat at its mooring, a few faint stars. Light: a soft pale moonlit glow from the upper left, lighting the planes of his face and leaving the river in mist; the whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, with darkened edges. Expression: an unmoving, level gaze in a hard weathered face that has outlasted winters.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the boat-leader the night she took forty disciples across the ice, calm and resolute.
people.subject: The moment: the boat-leader of the Cold Ford War on the night she took forty disciples across the ice, striding forward with a lantern held high and calling the line behind her, her portrait faded like old silk. Face: she is about forty-five, with a strong weathered brown face creased from squinting at ice, steady dark eyes, thick brows, a straight nose and a firm mouth. Hair: black with grey, tied back and pinned with a silver pin, a few strands whipped loose. Body: broad and braced, one arm half-raised as if beckoning, her coat swinging. Clothing: the old-style robe of Thúy Vi: green-grey silk hemmed in grey fur under a thick fur-trimmed coat of dark blue brocade belted at the waist, silver embroidery of waves along the borders, sleeves bound at the wrist with silk ribbon, and a jade pendant on the belt. Hands and objects: a small boat lantern held high in one fist on a staff, its flame lighting her chin and the white of her breath. Power: a pale blue frost of water qi glitters around the lantern and drifts across the ice in small motes of light, steady and strong. Background: a frozen river stretching into black night, small figures following in a line, a few stars. Light: a soft pale moonlit glow from the upper left with the warm lantern flame on her face; the whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, the edges darkened. Expression: resolute and brave, a calm forward-looking face that does not look back at the dark.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the hall head before his tribulation, still-water calm, a mirror in his hands.
people.subject: The moment: the head of Minh Kính Đường before his tribulation, holding a bowl of perfectly still water like a mirror in both hands, his portrait faded like old silk. Face: a long calm face of about fifty, pale as milk, with deep still unmoving eyes, thin brows, a straight nose and a closed mouth; the stillness has no tension, and his face is reflected in the water. Hair: black, in a plain knot under a slim pale jade crown. Body: lean and upright. Clothing: the robe of a hall head of Thúy Vi: soft green-grey silk in three crossed layers with a pale blue collar edged by a thin silver line, a translucent gauze over-robe, wide sleeves held carefully away from the water, a plain cord at the waist hung with a pale jade pendant, and faint embroidery of mist at the borders. Hands and objects: a white porcelain bowl with a rim edged in faint blue, the water in it perfectly still, a pale gleam resting on its surface. Power: a pale blue water qi sheen lies over the bowl and drifts around him in a few faint motes; deep and quiet, like the lull before a storm. Background: a dim hall by a forest river, a screen of pale paper, a faint blue gleam from a pool outside. Light: a soft pale moonlit glow from the upper left; the whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, with darkened edges. Expression: calm and settled, a mirror-like composure, like still water that is ready for what is coming.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the keeper of the coast pavilion on the night she held the point against pirates.
people.subject: The moment: the keeper of Lam Triều Các on the night she held the point against pirates, standing firm on a rocky headland with a tide-reading rod planted in her hand, her portrait faded like old silk. Face: she is about fifty, with a strong, weathered brown face, deep salt-wind lines, dark eyes narrowed against the dark, thick brows, a broad nose and a set jaw. Hair: black with grey, wind-blown, held by a silver pin and a blue ribbon. Body: broad and solid, braced on the rock with one foot forward, shoulders square against the wind. Clothing: the old-style robe of Thúy Vi: green-grey silk hemmed in dark blue with silver wave embroidery, crossed collars, a long sea-cape of dark blue brocade, wet and blowing out behind her, wide sleeves bound at the wrists with silk cord, and a jade pendant at the belt. Hands and objects: the tide rod, notched along its length, planted on the rock. Power: a faint blue water qi haze gathers around the rod and drifts across her shoulders in glittering spray, steady and strong. Background: black rocks and surf, a faint orange glow of fire far along the coast where a pavilion burns, and a lowering sky. Light: a soft pale moonlit glow from the upper left, the far orange glow edging her profile in red and leaving the rest in shadow; the whole picture faded and yellowed like old silk. Expression: a firm, steady face with eyes narrowed against the wind.
